why_useful: Searches multiple recent community and media sources and retains engagement metadata.
Discovery mode ranks emerging topics using cross-source evidence and momentum labels.
Can expose repeated requests, complaints and audience language before a topic appears in slower publishing reports.
Its opt-in Amazon lane can add current product prices, ratings and a bounded sample of recent written reviews.
limits: Engagement measures attention and conversation, not book purchases.
Polymarket volume concerns event beliefs and is not evidence that readers will buy a related book.
Amazon ratings and reviews are useful buyer evidence but do not reveal competitor unit sales or acquisition cost.
Coverage depends on configured sources, authentication and third-party availability; missing results are not negative demand evidence.
A 30-day window can overvalue short-lived spikes that close before production and discovery mature.

required_follow_up: Verify comparable book transactions or bounded traction proxies from independent origins.
Inspect relevant titles and reader-choice evidence in the target marketplace.
Estimate production lead time against the observed demand window.
Record source coverage and keep UNKNOWN distinct from NEGATIVE.

implementation.reason: RN10 was completed with direct sources; installing or scheduling the external skill is a separate operational choice.
implementation.recommended_trial: Use one bounded discovery query in the next run, then compare nomination precision and deep-scan yield against the direct-source baseline.
